description: Cross-binding search fidelity net (issue #2095 item C): one deterministic dataset plus fixed queries run through THREE production surfaces — core `VectorCollection` (search / hybrid_search), the REST server (`/collections/{name}/search` and `/search/hybrid`), and the WASM `VectorStore` — pinning result ids AND scores. `expect_ids`/`expect_scores` are the canonical golden, recorded from velesdb-core. `score_tolerance` covers kernel-level float ordering (core SIMD sums in a different order than the WASM scalar `metric.calculate`), nothing wider. `expected_divergences` is the documented allowlist of known per-surface semantic gaps: each entry names the surface override carried in `surface_expect`, the reason, and the tracking item — when a fix lands and a surface starts returning the canonical golden, its override must be deleted and this entry with it. The dataset stays <= 10 points so core brute-forces and no HNSW build randomness can leak into the pins.

cases.note: plain k-NN cosine: ranks the three x-axis-aligned docs in id order
plain k-NN euclidean: distance family different from cosine, same id+score contract
BM25+dense RRF with rrf_k=10, weight 0.5 — REST takes the same rrf_k through HybridSearchRequestWithRrf

expected_divergences.reason: WASM `VectorStore::hybrid_search` is a raw-score linear blend over a binary substring text match and has no rrf_k parameter; core fuses BM25 and dense ranks by RRF. Its actual output is pinned under surface_expect.wasm so the divergence is netted, not merely documented.
